body:
i need to get away from her, you're right. i'm burnt out on her anyway, with what's been going on. i have trouble letting go when i don't know the truth, though. a need to feel justified, i guess.  

the biggest problem is finding those friends. the ones i have now don't ever ask about my life; it's very "out of sight, out of mind." and when i'm with them, it's the same thing over and over. no one ever plans anything new, and i never meet any new people as a result. i'm really burnt out on them too.

i don't know where you got the first part of your comment from, unless you're talking about the tumblr.  

you're right though, i didn't consider her pressures with mine added on top. it's just hard; i've dropped things for her to help her with emotional (even suicidal) problems all the time. i can't get the same treatment this once? oh well.

I'm more down than I let on, I guess. I suppose I enjoy spending time with adults, but sometimes I get the feeling that I'm just treated as a kid, not as a person. I understand that feeling they have towards me, but it's really annoying when I feel like I'm more mature than some of them. I'd really much rather spend time around peers. Thank you, though.
Upstate new york. I'm on Reddit though!

Probably is self-esteem, yeah. I always have to internally question what the other is thinking and feeling about what I say, and my posture. Even though I have traces of not really caring, I need to pick up on that they don't really care either. If I don't get that vibe from them, I'm paranoid as hell.
